home_description: Monitor the temperature, humidity and condition of your BioBox in real time.
home_intro: Check the temperature, humidity and condition of your BioBox in real time without refreshing the page.
home_features_intro: Explore the main features of the BioBox platform in one place.
home_live_detail: Temperature, air humidity, soil moisture and light readings update automatically.
home_charts_detail: Charts show how conditions change over time.
home_status_detail: See the current condition of your BioBox and any important changes.
home_secure_detail: User accounts and permissions control access to the platform.
home_tech_title: From the plant to your screen.
home_tech_intro: One system connects the sensors, data processing and web platform.
home_measure_detail: Sensors continuously monitor conditions inside the BioBox.
home_process_detail: The readings are sent to the server and stored in the database.
home_visualize_detail: The platform displays current readings, trends over time and system status.
home_about_intro: BioBox combines smart sensors, automated controls and web technology so you can track plant growth and manage growing conditions.
home_about_project: BioBox is a diploma project. Its hardware, database and web platform work together as one system.
home_faq_intro: Answers to common questions about BioBox.
home_refresh_q: Do I need to refresh the page to see new readings?
home_refresh_a: No. New readings appear on the dashboard automatically once they are saved.
home_values_q: Which readings does the platform show?
home_values_a: Temperature, air humidity, soil moisture and light levels, along with past readings.
home_status_q: What do the status indicators mean?
home_status_a: They show whether components are active, inactive or need attention.
home_privacy_a: Signed-in users with the appropriate permissions.
home_cta: Keep an eye on your plants.
home_cta_detail: Sign in to explore what you can do with BioBox.
home_footer_detail: Smart plant monitoring with connected sensors and web technology.
